title: Cordyceps mind-controlling bullet ants

tellings.quote: Bullet ants in the Amazon eat cordyceps mushrooms, which co-opt their brains and movements and [inaudible] mind-control them onto higher ground where a fruiting body sprouts from the head of the ants.

plain: In the Amazon, Michels says, bullet ants eat cordyceps mushrooms, a fungus that takes over their brains and movements and steers them to higher ground, where a fruiting body, the mushroom's spore-bearing stalk, sprouts out of the ant's head. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, on an episode with the mushroom entrepreneur Tero Isokauppila that asks whether mushrooms could be a kind of alien mind control. He offers it as a real example of one living thing taking control of another's mind.
